subclaims.claim: Front obstacle initiates Stop; blocked sides at stop completion cause Backward.
Stop and Backward each last five command ticks.
After Backing only sides decide: right clear wins, left clear is fallback, otherwise Backward repeats.
Either turn lasts five command ticks then returns Forward.
Commands reach motor and avoiding stops cleaning using the split SD output modules.

paths_walked: main -> initialize_rvc -> reset_movement_controller -> reset_step_timer; initial state and timer reset read. Extra power-on output is a separate C13 divergence.

main -> wait_for_tick -> controller -> get_inputs -> detect_obstacle -> read_front/left/right_sensor -> assess_obstacle_situation; legacy polling differs from revised acquisition contract reviewed separately.
controller -> decide_actions -> movement_controller -> advance_step_timer -> conditional start_step_timer; all five states, all side classes, done/not-done, repeated step and reset inspected.
decide_actions -> derive_movement_status -> track_power_up -> decide_cleaning; power path does not modify movement.
controller -> put_outputs -> issue_movement_output -> drive_motor; put_outputs also calls drive_cleaner.
CMake control library and simulator use the same production sources; host provides sensor values and records outputs.
